run.install: python3 -m venv .agent-venv && .agent-venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt pytest requests pytest-playwright beautifulsoup4 && .agent-venv/bin/playwright install chromium

behaviours.description: GET /login renders the login form with email and password fields
POST /login with valid credentials redirects to / and flashes 'Logged in successfully!'
POST /login with wrong password shows 'Incorrect password, try again.'
POST /login with unknown email shows 'Email does not exist.'
GET /logout when logged in redirects to /login; when anonymous redirects to /login?next=...
GET /sign-up renders the sign-up form
POST /sign-up with valid data creates the user with a hashed password, logs in, flashes 'Account created!' and redirects to /
Sign-up rejects duplicate email, email <4 chars, first name <2 chars, mismatched passwords, password <7 chars with the specific flash messages
GET / requires login; anonymous users are redirected to /login
POST / with non-empty note stores it, flashes 'Note added!' and lists it on the page
POST / with empty note flashes 'Note is too short!' and stores nothing
POST /delete-note with JSON noteId deletes own note and returns {}; other users' notes are untouched
In the browser a user can sign up, add a note, delete it via the UI button, log out and log back in
Home page shows empty notes list and authenticated navigation (Logout, no Login/Sign Up)
Users only see their own notes
Note text is HTML-escaped on render
Notes are listed in insertion order
Success flashes use alert-success, error flashes alert-danger; flashes show once
Sign-up validation precedence and length boundaries
Login sets session and remember_token cookies; passwords are case-sensitive
Unknown route 404, wrong method 405, static index.js served
